name: Sharp Finite Coordinate Capacity in a Maximum Class
statement: The sixteen-state maximum class $C_\ast$ satisfies $W_2(C_\ast)=\sqrt2=\tau(C_\ast)^{-2}$. Thus even a realizable maximum class need not admit arbitrarily large coordinate intervals in every realization choice.
proof: Three separator rows and three coordinate-2-exclusive concepts bound every realizing cone by $W_2\le\min\{s+t,1/s,1/t\}\le\sqrt2$. The general interval comparison and the exact value $\tau(C_\ast)=2^{-1/4}$ give equality.
comments: This refutes universal interval widening; the interval criterion remains sufficient rather than necessary for geometric substitution.
